Turn subscribers into customers with targeted emails and automated sequences that nurture leads and drive repeat sales.

Make informed decisions with clear analytics and transparent reporting. We track key metrics and deliver insights that drive smarter growth.

item.title: Portfolio Details 1
item.dc:creator: Agenvix
item.content:encoded:
LUMIA

COSMETIC

Client

Lumina Cosmetics

Industry

Beauty & Skincare

Services

Brand Identity & Strategy

Timeline

8 Weeks

Beauty Brand

Transformation

Lumina Cosmetics approached us to redefine their brand identity and create a cohesive visual system that reflects their premium positioning, modern values, and growing global audience.

  • Brand discovery & market research
  • Defined brand positioning & tone
  • Designed a modern visual identity
  • Created a scalable brand system

The Solution

We delivered a complete rebrand that balances minimal aesthetics with bold expression giving Lumina a distinctive and recognizable presence across all touchpoints.

  • Brand discovery & market research
  • Defined brand positioning & tone
  • Designed a modern visual identity
  • Created a scalable brand system

Project Overview

The goal was to create a refined, recognizable brand identity that conveys elegance and trust while staying flexible across digital, print, and packaging.

Results

& Impact

Lumina Cosmetics approached us to redefine their brand identity and create a cohesive visual system that reflects their premium positioning, modern values, and growing global audience.

  • Brand discovery & market research
  • Defined brand positioning & tone
  • Designed a modern visual identity
  • Created a scalable brand system

Client Feedback

Agenic transformed our brand into something truly special. The new identity perfectly reflects who we are today while positioning us confidently for the future. Their strategic thinking, creativity, and attention to detail made the entire process seamless and impactful.

GeneFar Lopez

CEO at Lumina Cosmetics

Let’s Connect

Share your marketing goals — SEO, ad campaigns, social media, or anything in between.

Shibaji C. Roy
Marketing Manager

Let's Grow Your
Revenue Together

Where Creativity Meets

Creative Agency

From branding to campaigns, we bring bold ideas to life

Building Scalable Software
for Tomorrow

ENGINEERING THE FUTURE OF TECHNOLOGY

Expert software development team specializing in scalable web apps, mobile solutions.

Built With Modern Technlogy

We leverage cutting edge technologies to build robust, scalable,
and high-performance software solutions.

Solutions We've Built

Solutions We've Built

Explore the innovative software solutions we've developed for startups and enterprises across industries.

Explore all Projects

Cloud Sync Dashboard

Enterprise project management platform with real-time collaboration and analytics for 10,000+ users.

Health Track Mobile App

AI-powered health and fitness app with wearable integration and personalized workouts for iOS and Android.

Finance Flow API Platform

Secure payment platform with multi-currency support, fraud detection, and robust APIs.

E-Learning Platform

All-in-one learning management system for content delivery, tracking, and certification.

From concept to deployment, we deliver complete software solutions.

Services We Offer

Web Application Development

Modern, scalable web applications tailored to your business goals.

SaaS Platform Development

Complete SaaS development with multi-tenant systems and subscription management.

Cloud Solutions & DevOps

Modern DevOps and cloud infrastructure for reliable, automated deployments.

Mobile App Development

High-performance iOS and Android apps with intuitive UX and offline capabilities.

API Development & Integration

Well-documented APIs enabling smooth integration across applications.

Consulting & Technical Audit

Cloud infrastructure and DevOps automation with CI/CD, containers, and scalable cloud architecture.

Explore More Services

Real stories from teams who trust our expertise.

Michael Zhang

CTO at CloudSync

Agenvix built our SaaS platform from the ground up. Their technical expertise and attention to detail delivered a product that exceeded our expectations.

Sarah Johnson

CMO at HealthTrack

The mobile app they developed transformed our business. Fast, reliable, and beautifully designed. Our users love it and so do we.

David Kim

CEO at FinanceFlow

Working with Agenic was seamless. They understood our complex requirements and delivered a scalable solution on time and within budget.

Client Testimonials

Latest Insights

Technical articles and insights
to help you stay ahead

item.content:encoded:
About

Agenvix

The Engine Behind

500+ Brands

Agenvix is a full service digital agency bringing together design, marketing, eCommerce, and technology under one unified platform to help brands build, grow, and scale their digital presence.

Projects Delivered 0 + Average ROI Growth 0 %

Our Mission

To deliver smart digital solutions that help businesses grow, scale, and stand out.

Our Vision

To become a trusted global agency known for innovation, clarity, and measurable impact.

Our structured approach adapts to your unique goals, delivering clarity and consistent results.

How We Bring

Ideas to Life

Discover & Plan

We understand your goals, users, and challenges to define a clear, actionable roadmap.

Design / Build

Our team designs and develops solutions with precision, creativity, and attention to detail.

Test & Optimize

We test, refine, and optimize to ensure strong performance, usability, and quality.

Launch & Scale

We deploy with confidence and support future growth, scalability, and long-term success.

Tools & Technologies

We use modern tools and technologies to deliver secure,
scalable, and future-ready solutions.

Let’s Connect

Share your marketing goals — SEO, ad campaigns, social media, or anything in between.

Shibaji C. Roy
Marketing Manager

Let's Grow Your
Revenue Together
